                add_edge(graph, j * 50 + y, (j + 1) * 50 + x, 1, delta_cost);
            }
        }
    }
    
    ll total_flow = 0;
    ll total_cost = 0;
    
    while (total_flow < k_in) {
        vector<ll> dist(N_NODES, INF);
        vector<ll> parent(N_NODES, -1);
        vector<size_t> parent_edge_idx(N_NODES);
        vector<ll> in_queue(N_NODES, 0);

        dist[s] = 0;

        in_queue[s] = 1;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {

            in_queue[u] = 0;
            
            for (size_t i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.to]) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    parent[e.to] = u;
                    parent_edge_idx[e.to] = i;
                    if (!in_queue[e.to]) {

                        in_queue[e.to] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (dist[t] == INF) break;
        
        ll flow_add = k_in - total_flow;
        for (ll v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {

            flow_add = min(flow_add, graph[u][idx].cap - graph[u][idx].flow);

        for (ll v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
            ll u = parent[v];
            size_t idx = parent_edge_idx[v];
            ll rev_idx = graph[u][idx].rev;
            graph[u][idx].flow += flow_add;
            graph[v][rev_idx].flow -= flow_add;
            total_cost += graph[u][idx].cost * flow_add;

        total_flow += flow_add;
    }
